answer_1.quote: We conducted experiments on two representative tasks in natural language generation, which are text generation and machine translation.

answer_2.quote: We adopted automatic and human evaluations for constraint accuracy and text quality. Specifically, we finetuned two RoBERTa-based classifiers for the evaluations of sentiment and topic, used the perplexity (PPL) given by GPT-2 medium, averaged distinctness, BLEU, sacreBLEU, CSR, and accuracy metrics.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, each sentence received a score of 1 to 5 on sentiment and topic relevance as well as fluency given by three evaluators.
answer_4.guideline: Each sentence received a score of 1 to 5 on sentiment and topic relevance as well as fluency.
